caption: The drawing depicts a single, elongated metallic object with a handle on the left end and a branched, pronged structure on the right end. The object is colored in various shades of brown and muted rust, with slight blue and gray undertones, suggesting the appearance of aged or weathered metal. The pronged end forms two symmetrical, upright extensions with curled ends, both facing outward from the central stem of the object. Below this object, there is a simple outline showing the shape that the pronged end would create if pressed onto a surface: it consists of two "Y"-shaped lines, joined at their bases and slanting slightly away from each other. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned. In the bottom right corner, the name "Elizabeth Johnson" is written in small, neat letters.
title: Branding Iron
